facts.fact: The telecommunications department's ICT SMME Development Strategy, gazetted on 10 November 2017, says ICT incubation hubs exist in Gauteng, KwaZulu-Natal and Western Cape, and describes a high-tech incubation model adapted from current incubators, in which start-ups are incubated in digital innovation.
facts.system: ICT incubation hubs (Pretoria, Cape Town, Durban)

facts.fact: The ICT SMME Development Strategy, gazetted on 10 November 2017, says lessons can be learned from existing incubation hubs in Pretoria, Cape Town and Durban, and that the integrated ICT white paper calls for digital hubs in all district municipalities.
facts.system: ICT incubation hubs (Pretoria, Cape Town, Durban)

systems.owner: Department of Telecommunications and Postal Services

note: The strategy gives no count of start-ups or cohorts for the existing hubs.
